title: Rebate Program Terms: Manufacturer Seasonal Rebate on Replacement System Installations
content:
# Manufacturer seasonal rebate — Replacement System Installations

**Term 1 — Rebate earned.** A package whose manufacturer seasonal rebate is above 0.00 earns that rebate as a manufacturer rebate credit naming the contract-price charge.

**Term 2 — Qualifying installation.** The rebate is credited only when the project's installation date falls within the package's qualifying installation dates, both end dates included.

**Term 3 — Time of posting.** The rebate is posted on or after the installation date, never at signing.

**Term 4 — Signing date irrelevant.** A project signed inside the qualifying dates but installed after them earns nothing; a project signed before the qualifying dates but installed inside them qualifies.

**Term 5 — Once only.** The rebate is posted once per project and is not available on a cancelled project.

The installation date and the package are read from the project's system record.

## Boundary cases (qualifying dates 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30, hypothetical projects)

| Signed | Installed | Rebate |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-20 | 2026-09-01 | Earned — first qualifying day, end date included |
| 2026-11-10 | 2026-11-30 | Earned — last qualifying day, end date included |
| 2026-11-10 | 2026-12-01 | Not earned — installed after the qualifying dates |
| 2026-08-01 | 2026-08-31 | Not earned — installed before the qualifying dates |
| 2026-10-05 | Not yet installed | Not yet — never posted at signing |

A package with a seasonal rebate of 0.00 earns nothing on any date.
